description: RED fixture cannot catch the production regression. The only reapable fixture (b) is created with `git merge --no-ff` (a true merge commit), but production uses squash-merge (design line 50). The entire suite (PROP-006, PROP-029, dry-run/confirmed-delete assertions) exercises a merge mode that does not occur in production and cannot catch FIND-001/FIND-002. False green: tests pass while the janitor is inert/unsafe on real squash-merged branches.

evidence.snippet: git checkout main && git merge --no-ff feature/wt-b -m "merge wt-b"

fix: Add fixture (e): a squash-merged branch (`git merge --squash` + trunk commit, leftover feature/wt-e worktree) with explicit expected classification; add PROPs asserting squash-merged branches are correctly classified and reaped/refused per the chosen design.
